units.source_en: Applying

paragraphs.source_en: To Your Life 1. The first step in practicing the Law of Victory is taking responsibility for the success of the team, department, or organization you lead. It must become personal. Your commitment must be higher than that of your team members. Your passion should be high. Your dedication must be unquestioned. Do you currently demonstrate that kind of commitment? If not, you need to examine yourself to determine if it is in you. If you search yourself and are unable to convince yourself to bring that kind of commitment, then one of three things is probably true: You are pursing the wrong vision. You are in the wrong organization. You are not the right leader for the job. You will have to make adjustments accordingly. 2. If you are dedicated to leading your team to victory, you will be able to achieve it only if you have the right people on the team.
